about: Animated look (how-to card): opening of a Communication Clarity guide.

scenes.narration: Better questions lead to better conversations.

lines: We rarely plan what we ask.

scenes.narration: Most of us spend far more effort on what we say than on what we ask. Yet a well chosen question often does more than a clever answer.
Ask a friend, was it good, and you get a shrug.
Ask, what was the best part of the trip, and you get a story.
This guide covers open, clarifying and follow up questions, asking one thing at a time, and using why with care.
Notice the next three questions you ask today. Were they ones that invited a real answer, or ones that could be answered with a shrug?
